slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

hardest thing first

do the one task you're dreading before 10am, every day for a week. starting the day with a win you didn't want teaches your brain that you can be trusted.

asking for feedback

ask 3 people this week what they think your biggest strength is. most people never ask, and hearing the answer out loud quietly changes how you carry yourself.

public workouts

do one workout a week somewhere public: a park, a beach, an outdoor gym. being bad at something while people can see you is where real confidence gets trained.

commute lessons

use the first 5 minutes of your commute to learn one new thing about history, science or art. people who keep learning never run out of things to say, and that calm shows.
slides.texte_sophia:
commute lessons

use the first 5 minutes of your commute to learn one new thing about history, science or art. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you never run out of things to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
ten second decisions

for small choices this week, food, clothes, which film, decide in 10 seconds and don't look back. overthinking tiny decisions trains you to doubt the big ones too.
